fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5% of weekly Net Sales, paid weekly via ACH. Brand Marketing Fee is 2% of weekly Net Sales, paid weekly via ACH. Local Marketing and Promotion minimum is the greater of 5% of Net Sales or $2,000/month (cooperatives may require up to 7.5% of Net Sales). Online Ordering Fee: $0.35 per online transaction (capped at 5% increase per 12-month period). Customer Relations Management: $10/month. Loyalty Program: $53/month. Gift Card Redemption Fee: 6.06%-13.63% of redemption amount. Food Service Incident Management: $3/month. Store Solutions Team Support: $49/month. POS Software Support/Subscription/Maintenance/Hosting: $95-$600/month. Managed Firewall Service/Network Security: $30-$90/month. Business Class High Speed Internet: $50-$200/month (third party). Secure Payment Gateway: $11-$25/month. Bookkeeping/Payroll Service: $0-$630/month (third party). Transfer Fee ranges from $7,500-$25,000 depending on transferee type and years remaining. Interest: 1.5%/month (18% per annum) on unpaid amounts. tech_fee_monthly set to null as multiple tech-related fees exist with ranges rather than a single disclosed monthly amount.
